data.title: bn-28kv4: capability instance scope for 18 of 19 handle classes; protocol 3.7 / IDL 1.15

data.body: [HIGH] Revalidate the full delegated grant chain before subscription delivery. This lookup accepts any registered leaf and skips expiry, connection ancestry, parent existence, and per-hop narrowing. Sequence: open evidence.subscribe with a delegated child, commit an event, revoke its parent, then call deliver. revoke_capability removes only the parent at daemon/state.rs:527-529, so this branch still emits the protected event. Parent replacement with a narrower grant has the same stale-authority problem. Reuse the full admission validity and ancestry checks at delivery with an explicit time reading. Add tests for parent revocation, expiry, and parent narrowing between commit and delivery.

[HIGH] Derive the class claim from evidence_root instead of hard-coding ev. ContextCompileRequest uses generic ArtifactHandle, and put_compile_source accepts the same type at daemon/state.rs:753-759. A task_ or unknown-prefix key can reach compile_source while admission checks only ctx and ev classes. InstanceScope::admits returns true for unknown prefixes at admission.rs:249-253. A capability without task authority can therefore compile a registered task_ source. Reject non-ev roots or classify the supplied handle and claim its actual class. Add denial tests for non-ev and unknown prefixes.

[MEDIUM] This new error arm exposes the raw cap_ bearer token through Display. RFC 0026 line 576 and RFC 0027 line 115 forbid capability tokens in error text. Builder::build interpolates this refusal into its panic at daemon/mod.rs:1111. Any invalid instances member can copy the credential into logs or crash reports. Render only a stable redacted marker or fingerprint. Assert that ProvisioningRefusal::Instance Display never contains the input token.

[HIGH-RISK CHECKLIST] Failure modes: class confusion bypasses T2, stale delegated subscriptions disclose events, and provisioning errors disclose bearer tokens. Edge cases: parent revocation, expiry, parent replacement, multiple subscriptions, non-ev or unknown prefixes, empty lists, duplicates, and protocol 3.6 omission. Rollback: revert the 3.7 wire field and enforcement together, then restore 3.6. Never weaken only admission. Monitoring: count denials and suppressed deliveries by category without handles or tokens. Alert on any post-revocation frame. Validation: test full-chain delivery authorization, dynamic class binding, refusal redaction, per-class delegation narrowing, and older-version welcome behavior. Any risk:critical human approval remains required. This Seal vote cannot satisfy that gate.

data.reason: Two high-severity authorization bypasses remain: subscription delivery ignores parent revocation and validity, and context.compile does not bind a generic handle to its actual class. Provisioning refusal also exposes a bearer capability token.

data.body: Fixed in 0bd4c06. context.compile claims the root's own class (class_of prefix), so a task_ root needs task authority. The handler then refuses any non-ev_ root with MalformedRequest before lookup. put_compile_source refuses non-ev_ roots (NotAnEvidenceRoot). Admission denies a named instance of no class or of an unclaimed class. InstanceScope::admits now returns false for an unknown prefix. Tests: gate_g1_07 a_compile_root_is_claimed_as_its_own_class_..., a_named_instance_outside_the_claimed_classes_is_denied, an_unknown_prefix_fails_closed_...; gate_g2_05 a_compile_projection_registers_only_under_an_evidence_root. Each was mutation-checked.

Fixed in 0bd4c06. T4 is factored into admission::standing: registered, actor bound, unexpired at the deployment's reading, and the full chain with per-hop narrowing. Delivery re-decides it per subscription before every pass. A failed chain closes the subscription with SubscriptionClosed::StandingLost and sends nothing on the wire (R1). Daemon::set_now supplies the explicit reading (INV-005). This also found a D4 defect: an empty child scope list passed under any parent. It is fixed. Tests: evidence_subscription standing::{revoking_the_parent_..., an_expiry_passed_before_delivery_..., a_parent_narrowed_below_the_delegate_...}. Each commits, changes the chain, then delivers. The old leaf-only lookup fails all three.

Fixed in 0bd4c06. ProvisioningRefusal Display names the actor and <redacted>, never the token, in both variants. ArtifactClassRefusal::Unknown also redacts a cap_ token pasted into artifact_classes. CapabilityHandle Debug was already redacted. Audit of other Display impls in admission, capability, identity, handshake and transport: no token rendering. Tests: gate_g1_07 a_provisioning_refusal_never_renders_the_capability_token. The gate_g2_02 pin that required the token in the message now asserts its absence.

Addressed in 0bd4c06: class binding, full-chain delivery re-authorization, refusal redaction, and D4 empty-list narrowing, each with tests. The 3.6 omission path is unchanged (welcome test). Rollback note accepted: the wire field and enforcement revert together. Denial and suppression counters are not added in this change. Human approval gate left to the lead.

[HIGH] Revalidate ancestry when the presented capability equals the connection capability. standing skips admissible_on_connection at admission.rs:240-243. welcome accepts any registered leaf without checking its parent at capability.rs:234-240. Revocation removes only the parent at state.rs:527-529. A delegated child can therefore open its own connection, survive parent revocation or narrowing, and keep requests and subscriptions authorized. This violates D8 and R1. Always validate the stored parent chain for delegated grants, even at the connection root. Add request and delivery tests where the connection capability itself has a parent, then revoke, expire, or narrow that parent.

[HIGH] Check the task resolved from the continuation against task instance scope before any read or write. The scope claim lists only request.continuation at task.rs:963-965. resume resolves continuation.task at task.rs:1558, returns its terminal record at task.rs:1594-1603, and mutates or advances it at task.rs:1633-1697 without admits_instance. A grant scoped to task_A and cont_B can therefore resume and observe task_B. This violates per-class derived-artifact isolation. Deny before materialize and before any response. Add terminal and live tests with listed cont_B and unlisted task_B, with and without a budget.

[HIGH-RISK CHECKLIST] Failure modes: a delegated connection survives ancestor loss; task.resume crosses task instance scope. Edge cases: child-as-connection, parent removal, replacement, or expiry, terminal, live, or restored tasks, budget present or absent, and mismatched task and continuation lists. Rollback: revert protocol 3.7 and every enforcement path together. Never leave partial admission. Monitoring: count standing-loss and cross-scope resume denials without tokens or handles. Alert on post-revocation requests or frames. Validation: test ancestor loss on a child connection and zero-trace resume denial for a listed continuation plus unlisted task. Risk-critical human approval remains mandatory. This Seal vote cannot satisfy it.

data.reason: Two HIGH authorization bypasses remain: delegated connection capabilities skip ancestor standing checks, and task.resume can mutate an unlisted task through a listed continuation.

data.body: Fixed in 6ebe269. standing now always runs chain_stands. It walks the stored chain from the presented capability to its root: every parent registered, every hop narrowing, and the connection is the capability itself or an ancestor. This also covers the case where the presented capability is the connection's. welcome now decides T4 through admission::standing, and delivery already did. Test: evidence_subscription standing::a_delegated_connection_capability_does_not_outlive_its_parent. The child is the connection capability, then the parent is revoked, the parent is narrowed, or the child expires. The next request is denied, delivery is suppressed and closed, and a new handshake is refused. Mutation-checked.

Fixed in 6ebe269. resume calls continuation_scope right after resolving the continuation, before the staleness checks, any read or write, or the terminal answer. It decides the task, the snapshot and the intent with Call::derived and admission::admits_derived. Test: gate_g1_07 a_resume_is_refused_when_the_continuations_task_is_outside_the_scope. It covers a live task and a terminal task, each with and without a budget, under a grant that lists cont_B and another task. It asserts CapabilityDenied, no payload, no task on the envelope, an unchanged status and an unchanged store audit, with a listed-task control. Mutation-checked. The audit of the same pattern across every operation is fixed in the same commit and listed in the IDL rule.

Addressed in 6ebe269. Child-as-connection: revocation, narrowing and expiry are tested at request, delivery and handshake. task.resume: terminal and live, with and without a budget. The derived-handle sweep covers the task, verification, workspace, intent, evidence, observe, context and whiteboard families, and the traversal is bounded to in-scope edges. Counters for denials and suppressed deliveries are still not added. The human approval gate is left to the lead.

cada05a adds the counters on existing seams, with no new dependency. AdmissionRecord.denial is Admission or DerivedHandle, and DaemonState::denial_counts reads the counts off the P5 admission log. Server::suppressed_deliveries counts standing_lost and out_of_scope. No count carries a handle, actor or token, and nothing about them reaches the wire. Table-driven derived-handle tests now cover intent, evidence.get, evidence.link, observe.ingest, context.compile and context.expand, whiteboard.compile, and the traversal. A 12-mutant sample (each family's check removed) killed all 12.

[MEDIUM] Redact pasted capability tokens from Debug as well as Display. ArtifactClassRefusal derives Debug at provisioning.rs:52-66, and Unknown retains the caller-supplied String. A descriptor with artifact_classes = ["cap_<bearer>"] is refused, but logging the ordinary Result with {:?} prints that token. This bypasses the Display redaction at provisioning.rs:69-85 and violates RFC 0027 S5. Implement a custom Debug or retain a redacted value. Assert that both Display and Debug omit the token for the direct ArtifactClassRefusal and nested ProvisioningRefusal.

[HIGH-RISK CHECKLIST] Failure modes: Debug can disclose a pasted cap_ bearer token; the corrected class binding, delegation standing, derived-handle checks, and delivery filtering otherwise fail closed. Edge cases: direct and nested refusal Debug, alternate-format logging, parent revocation or narrowing, child-as-connection, terminal tasks, and scope-list omission. Rollback: revert protocol 3.7 and all enforcement paths together. Never retain only the field or only admission. Monitoring: scan logs for capability-token patterns, count categorized denials and suppressed deliveries without identifiers, and alert on post-revocation frames. Validation: assert Debug and Display redaction, then retain the full-chain, class-confusion, derived-handle, and delivery tests. Risk-critical human approval remains mandatory. This Seal BLOCK cannot satisfy it.
Verified at cada05a. standing always calls chain_stands, including when presented equals connection. The bounded walk reaches the root and rechecks every narrowing hop.
Verified at cada05a. The claim uses the root prefix, admission rejects unknown or undeclared classes, compile rejects non-ev roots before lookup, and registration accepts only ev roots.
Verified the reported Display path at cada05a. Display redacts both descriptor tokens and cap_ strings pasted into artifact_classes. The distinct remaining Debug leak is tracked in th-1xgy3u.
Verified at cada05a. continuation_scope checks task, snapshot, and intent before staleness checks, terminal answers, materialization, or writes.
Verified at cada05a. Delivery rechecks standing before reading the event tail. Lost standing removes the subscription before any frame is encoded.

data.reason: MEDIUM blocker th-1xgy3u: ArtifactClassRefusal derives Debug while retaining a caller-supplied cap_ bearer string, so ordinary Debug logging can disclose the credential despite Display redaction. Add fail-closed Debug redaction and direct plus nested regression tests. Risk-critical human approval remains a separate mandatory gate.

data.body: Fixed in 2141e4e. artifact_class() now stores a fixed cap_<redacted> marker in ArtifactClassRefusal::Unknown when the spelling is a cap_ token, so the token is never retained. ArtifactHandle Debug also redacts a cap_ spelling. Test gate_g1_07 a_provisioning_refusal_never_renders_the_capability_token checks Display, {:?} and {:#?}, on the refusal alone and inside ProvisioningRefusal. Both redactions are mutation-checked. Sweep: CapabilityHandle and CapabilityToken already had redacted Debug and have no Display. The crate has no serde Serialize. AdmissionRecord.capability, ProvisioningRefusal.capability, Subscription and ReplayKey hold CapabilityHandle, which prints <redacted>. InstanceRefusal never holds a cap_ member (the Capability variant carries none). Free-text request strings, such as a note body, are caller content and out of scope.

Verified at 2141e4e. artifact_class retains cap_<redacted> instead of the supplied bearer, and ArtifactHandle has a custom redacting Debug implementation. Direct, nested, and alternate Debug paths cannot retain the token.

[HIGH] Authorize each generated continuation before publication or reporting. verification.rs:678-695 derives a cont_* identity, verification.rs:782 publishes it, verification.rs:817 parks it, and verification.rs:1280 reports it. advance has no Call or grant. verification.start checks only the task at verification.rs:1128, while task.resume reaches the same advance path at task.rs:1716. A grant can therefore list an allowed task and a different cont_* instance, then receive a newly generated unlisted continuation. The store enforces class scope, not the new instance scope. Failure modes: publish, park, and disclose an unauthorized continuation from start or resume. Edge cases: fresh versus resumed runs, suspended versus closed runs, convergent identities, publication aborts, empty instance lists, and protocol 3.6. Rollback: revert the 3.7 field and every enforcement path together. Do not retain partial instance enforcement. Monitoring: count generated-continuation denials without handles or tokens, and alert on any successful suspended response outside the effective grant. Validation: add deterministic start and resume tests with an allowed task plus a sibling continuation. Require CapabilityDenied, no publication, no state change, and positive controls for listed and unscoped continuations.

[HIGH] Reauthorize cached mutation outcomes under the current grant. Admission uses the current capability at mod.rs:598-606, but an actor-scoped replay returns the old outcome at mod.rs:638-640 before Call::derived can run. ReplayKey deliberately omits capability at state.rs:425-430 and state.rs:449-480. One actor can execute under a broad grant, then replay the same request and key under a narrower grant that admits the named input but excludes the derived output. The cached payload and artifact list disclose that out-of-scope handle. Failure modes: disclose cached snapshots, intents, evidence, tasks, or continuations after authority narrows or a different same-actor token retries. Edge cases: sibling tokens, re-provisioned grants, delegated-parent narrowing, cached successes, non-retryable failures with recovery data, and protocol 3.6. Rollback: revert protocol 3.7 and its enforcement together, or disable cross-authority replay until reauthorization exists. Monitoring: count replay authority mismatches by category only, and alert when a replay is served under a different effective grant. Validation: execute once under broad scope, then replay under narrow scope that admits inputs but excludes outputs. Require CapabilityDenied or complete safe reauthorization, no leaked payload, artifacts, or recovery, plus an equivalent-authority positive control.

[HIGH-RISK CHECKLIST] Failure modes: generated continuations bypass instance scope, and cached mutation outcomes disclose derived handles outside the current grant. Edge cases: start or resume suspension, sibling same-actor tokens, grant replacement or parent narrowing, cached failures with recovery data, and 3.6 omission. Rollback: revert the 3.7 field and all enforcement together, or disable affected generation and cross-authority replay paths. Never retain partial admission. Monitoring: count generated-handle denials and replay authority mismatches without identifiers. Alert on out-of-scope suspended responses or replayed artifacts. Validation: test start and resume against sibling continuation scope, then broad-first and narrow-replay mutations across every derived-output family. Assert zero publication, state change, payload, artifacts, and recovery on denial. Risk-critical human approval remains mandatory. This Seal BLOCK cannot satisfy that gate.

data.reason: Two HIGH authorization bypasses remain at 2141e4e: generated continuations are published and reported without instance-scope authorization, and idempotency replays return cached derived handles without reauthorization under the current grant. Risk-critical human approval remains separate.

data.body: Fixed in 7aa7111. verification.start and task.resume forecast the continuation the run would park under, using the same deterministic run and pin preimage (verification::forecast_continuation, budget::bounds_after). They decide it with Call::derived before the first write, so a refusal creates no task entry and writes no budget, record or publication. admission::admits_every skips the forecast when the grant admits every cont. Test: gate_g1_07 a_minted_continuation_is_authorized_before_anything_is_written. It covers start and resume under a sibling cont (refused; no task, same record, same store audit), a listed minted cont (served, and the forecast equals the minted handle), and an unscoped cont (served). Both forecasts are mutation-checked.

Fixed in 7aa7111. The replay ledger now records the recording grant. A replay is served only when admission::covers(presenting, recorded) holds on level, snapshots, intents, classes, instances per class and profile, or when the presenting grant admits every handle the recorded outcome names. That second check walks the canonical JSON of the envelope, payload, error data and recovery offers and fails closed. It skips only ArtifactRef.commitment, a content hash, and status tokens. Admission decides the presenting capability's standing first. A mismatch is CapabilityDenied with no payload, task, continuation, artifacts or recovery, counted as Denial::ReplayAuthority. Test: gate_g1_07 a_replayed_outcome_is_reauthorized_under_the_presenting_capability. It covers a sibling token, grant replacement, parent narrowing and a cached StaleSnapshot with a reseal offer. The controls are an equal-authority unscoped grant (the 3.6 shape) and an exactly-listed grant. The covers and walk checks are mutation-checked.

Round 6 in 7aa7111: minted continuations are forecast and authorized before any write, and replays are reauthorized under the presenting grant. The IDL rule, RFC 0026 c52 and RFC 0027 c33 now remove the minted-handle exemption. The counters gain replay_authority. Human approval gate left to the lead.

[MEDIUM] Replay still bypasses the capability-relative recovery rule. Dispatch accepts descriptor coverage or the handle-only replay scan at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/mod.rs:647-648. replay_admitted at mod.rs:846-895 checks recovery arguments but never re-runs the N2 admission used at mod.rs:996-1017 for each offered operation. A same-actor sibling or replaced grant can admit the replayed request and every returned handle while its profile denies workspace.seal. The cached stale-snapshot outcome still offers workspace.seal. admission.rs:551-553 also lets an absent recording profile satisfy covers despite new denied_operations. Reauthorize every recovery operation and next operation under the presenting grant. Add profile-narrowing replay tests, not only snapshot narrowing.

[HIGH] Reapply the current grant before each subscription delivery. subscriber_standing at transport/mod.rs:520-535 checks only T4. Delivery then builds InstanceScope at transport/mod.rs:750-758, which ignores authority level, artifact_classes, and denied_operations. Re-registering the same token with a narrower descriptor can remove ev authority or deny evidence.subscribe while the open subscription remains standing and still receives events at transport/mod.rs:765-770. Failure modes: post-narrowing evidence disclosure and continued streaming after operation denial. Edge cases: same-token level reduction, ev class removal, profile denial, absent instances, and multiple subscriptions. Rollback: close subscriptions on any descriptor replacement until full admission can run at delivery. Monitoring: count closures caused by current T1-T3 or class failure, and alert on post-narrowing frames. Validation: open under a broad grant, replace the leaf descriptor with each narrower form, append an event, and require closure with no frame.

[HIGH] Authorize every handle embedded in a Context Pack before publication or expansion. compile checks only snapshot, intent, and header evidence at context.rs:792-799, then emits SelectedItem.artifact and CompileHeader.replay at context.rs:852-897. pack_scope repeats the incomplete set at context.rs:734-750, while expand returns inherited and selected content at context.rs:1254-1317. A grant scoped to one evidence root and Context Pack can receive an unlisted selected ev_, crash_, or other artifact handle and its summary. Failure modes: cross-instance handle and semantic-summary disclosure through compile or expand. Edge cases: selected artifacts outside header evidence, replay handles, root and child packs, redacted rows, and convergent packs. Rollback: disable instance-scoped context operations or revert 3.7 enforcement together. Monitoring: count derived-handle denials by pack field without logging handles. Validation: register a source whose selected artifact and replay handle are excluded, then require zero pack publication and CapabilityDenied for compile and expand, with listed and class-scoped controls.

[HIGH] The forecast fix creates an unaccounted exhaustion path. forecast_continuation runs the full BFS and checker at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/verification.rs:574-576. Start invokes it before task insertion at verification.rs:1298-1312. Resume invokes it before budget or region work at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/task.rs:1675-1700. A valid execute grant can admit the task or input continuation but exclude the minted continuation. Fresh idempotency keys repeat up to 2^20 states and 2^22 transitions before CapabilityDenied, with no task, region, budget charge, or publication. Failure modes: CPU or memory exhaustion, head-of-line blocking, and quota-accounting bypass. Edge cases: start and resume, absent or large state limits, and fresh replay keys. Rollback: do not restore unauthorized minting. Fail closed for continuation-scoped runs until forecast work is admitted, charged, bounded, or safely cached. Monitoring: correlate derived-handle denials with latency and CPU when no task or region appears. Validation: instrument exploration cost, repeat mismatched calls with fresh keys, and require bounded, charged, region-owned work.

[HIGH-RISK CHECKLIST] Failure modes: Context Packs disclose out-of-scope handles and summaries; open subscriptions survive same-token T1-T3 or class narrowing; minted-continuation authorization consumes full unaccounted exploration before denial; replayed recovery offers bypass current profile denial. Edge cases: compile and expand, selected and replay fields, same-token replacement, start and resume, fresh keys, absent profiles, cached failures, and older-version omission. Rollback: revert protocol 3.7 and every enforcement path together, or disable the affected scoped context, subscription, continuation, and cross-authority replay paths. Monitoring: correlate derived and replay denials with CPU and latency, count delivery closures for all current admission dimensions, and alert on post-narrowing frames. Validation: add negative controls for every omitted Context Pack handle, same-token subscription narrowing, bounded and charged forecast work, and profile-denied replay recovery. Risk-critical human approval remains mandatory. This Seal BLOCK cannot satisfy that gate.

data.reason: Unresolved high-severity scope leaks in Context Pack output and subscription delivery, plus unaccounted continuation-forecast exhaustion. Replay recovery also bypasses current profile denial.

data.body: Fixed in 6f1b7fa. pack_scope now authorizes every embedded handle: snapshot, intent, evidence, replay, parent, context_id, debugger_branch and selected[].artifact. compile first decides the whole registered projection (source_scope: header, replay, every item any expansion could select) and the pack identity, before any stage runs. expand decides the child identity before the walk and the child document before it returns. One out-of-scope handle refuses the whole call, because INV-007 has no omission reason for scope (F24), so no partial pack is returned. Test: gate_g2_05 a_pack_whose_item_or_replay_is_outside_the_grant_is_not_compiled covers the item, the expansion-only item, the replay, expand of the child, and controls. Mutation-checked.

Fixed in 6f1b7fa. Delivery calls Daemon::readmit before every pass, which re-runs the full admission of the subscribing evidence.subscribe request (T1-T4, classes, instances, profile denial, chain standing) against the current registry and time. A failure closes the subscription (StandingLost). Test: evidence_subscription standing::a_grant_re_registered_narrower_closes_its_subscription, with same-token ev class removal, profile denial of evidence.subscribe, and an unchanged control. Mutation-checked.

Redesigned in 6f1b7fa per the lead ruling. forecast_continuation is gone, and there is one run. The minted cont_ is authorized after the run and before any write. On refusal the results are discarded: the staged publication is dropped, nothing is published, a task the start created is removed, and a resumed task's budget write and milestones are restored. The exploration is charged to the presenting capability (TaskTable::refused_work) and counted as a derived-handle denial. The same run (capability, task, from-continuation, bounds) is refused again before any exploration, so fresh idempotency keys buy nothing. The memo is per capability, so one caller cannot poison a shared task identity. Test: gate_g1_07 a_minted_continuation_is_authorized_before_anything_is_written (no task, no publication, charged, a repeat runs nothing, the resumed task record is unchanged, and listed and unscoped controls on the same daemon). Mutation-checked.

Fixed in 6f1b7fa. On replay, recovery offers are first re-run through N2 under the presenting capability, and any offer it denies is dropped. The covers-or-handle-walk check then runs on what remains. covers is fail-closed on profiles: a child or recording grant with no profile no longer narrows or covers a grant that has denied_operations (profile_narrows fixed; this also closes a delegation deny-list escape). Tests: gate_g1_07 replay covers a snapshot-scoped sibling and a workspace.seal-denied sibling (offer dropped), plus a direct covers check. a_delegate_with_no_profile_does_not_escape_its_parents_deny_list covers the delegation case. Mutation-checked.
Round 7 addressed in 6f1b7fa, together with an independent adversarial review of the whole range. Its findings and dispositions are in the bone comment. The human approval gate is left to the lead.

[HIGH][VERIFIED] Fixed at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/context.rs:741-778, 805-838, 964, 1241, and 1352. source_scope checks every projection handle before compilation. pack_scope checks every root and child document handle before registration or return. The generated pack identities are also checked before work. Out-of-scope selected, expansion-only, replay, inherited, and child handles now fail closed with no partial pack.

[HIGH][VERIFIED] Fixed at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/mod.rs:670-699, 886-935, and 1011-1071, plus crates/continuumd/src/daemon/admission.rs:330-336 and 487-521. Replay first filters recovery through current admission. It then requires descriptor coverage or complete canonical outcome-handle admission. Profile narrowing carries parent deny lists, so a current workspace.seal denial removes the cached offer.

[HIGH][VERIFIED] Fixed at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/verification.rs:607-727 and 1266-1305, plus crates/continuumd/src/daemon/task.rs:1726-1823 and 276-294. One bounded run derives the continuation. Authorization occurs before durable writes. A denial discards staged publication, removes a new task, or restores the resumed task. RefusedRun caches the deterministic capability, task, source continuation, and bounds tuple, so fresh idempotency keys cannot repeat that exploration.

[HIGH][VERIFIED] Fixed at crates/continuumd/src/transport/mod.rs:711-742 and crates/continuumd/src/daemon/mod.rs:406-429. Each delivery pass replays full admission for the original subscription request against the current descriptor, chain, and time. Lost level, class, instance, profile, actor, expiry, or ancestry closes the subscription before event inspection.

[HIGH-RISK CHECKLIST] Failure modes: the reviewed paths could disclose out-of-scope handles through named, derived, minted, replayed, pack, or streamed results; delegated authority could survive ancestor loss; errors could expose bearer tokens. Edge cases: protocol 3.6 omission, absent and empty per-class scopes, same-token replacement, child-as-connection ancestry, cached recovery, root and child packs, start and resume, terminal tasks, and multiple subscriptions. Rollback: revert protocol 3.7 and all instance-scope enforcement together, or disable the affected paths. Never retain partial enforcement. Monitoring: count admission, derived-handle, replay-authority, refused-work, and suppressed-delivery categories without identifiers. Scan logs for capability-token patterns. Alert on post-revocation, post-narrowing, or out-of-scope output. Validation: the exact range statically preserves fail-closed checks and includes focused regression and mutation evidence for each corrected path. Reviewer execution was intentionally omitted because this session may write only Seal metadata. Risk-critical human approval remains mandatory. This Seal LGTM cannot satisfy that gate.
